purpose: Check a memory or ask oneself to recall a detail.
keywords: Plain form / です / でした + っけ
What time was the meeting again?
Which door was this key for again?
formation: Plain form / です / でした + っけ
restrictions: Use with familiar people or self-directed questions.
mistake: It is not a general substitute for polite か when asking new information.
